notes.title: Ver 1.0.13.001 Update
notes.content:
Season 2 launched.
 Fixed a bug where the attack guide only displayed one skill.
 Fixed an issue where mech positions were displayed incorrectly on the battlefield after displacement.
 In the team selection screen, clicking a mech under repair will now redirect to the repair interface.
 Added expansion function for Core Packages.
 Localization updates.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.10.001 Update
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where a character in Deathmatch state could be killed by third-party damage without the Deathmatch state being removed.
 Fixed the victory condition description for Mission 49.
 Fixed a bug in Buster skill configuration for Mission 50.
 Fixed black screen issue during loading on low-spec devices.
 Fixed a bug where the Chainsaw weapon’s normal attack had no sound effect.
 Added quality color display for sub-mechs when upgrading.
 Added optimized log reporting functionality.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.9.001 Update
notes.content:
Added the ability to view secondary mech skill information during mech upgrades.
 Fixed several bugs that caused client crashes during battles.
 Fixed a bug where mechs overlapped on the battlefield.
 Fixed a bug where skill effects for support professions disappeared.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.8.001 Update
notes.content:
Fixed collision detection bug for the Charge skill
 Added visual effects for protected mechs in stages
 Fixed client crash issues during stage battles
 Fixed Auction House bug where entering a price for one mech affected others
 Fixed abnormal action list data during battles
 Localization updates
 PvP matches now default to “Accept”

notes.title: Ver 1.0.7.001 Update
notes.content:
Fixed bug where locked mecha could not be upgraded as the main mecha
 Fixed battle start time calculation error
 Fixed inconsistent PVP reset times across different time zones
 Fixed several localization errors
 Fixed abnormal behavior of Chain Thunder skill
 Added team filter function in Mecha Repair
 Optimized forest resources in Canyon map

notes.title: Ver 1.0.6.001 Update
notes.content:
Penalty time for declining battle matchmaking adjusted to 15 minutes.
 Added Mech Lock function in the Hangar.
 Added persistent visual effects for Deathmatch state.
 Added a button in the Settings menu to open the cache folder.
 Optimized in-battle skill info window for adaptive display.
 Sniper skill "Hit-and-Run" tactic adjusted to retreat 1–2 tiles.
 Adjusted the position of Marquee Announcements.
 Fixed a bug where personal permanent ranking on the Battle Leaderboard failed to refresh.
 Fixed a bug where values displayed as negative on the Battle Result screen.
 Fixed incorrect localization text.
 Fixed a bug where reset counts did not synchronize correctly.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.5.001 Update
notes.content:
Fixed – Localization text errors.
 Fixed – String parsing bug for Russian, Korean, and French.
 Fixed – Missing characters caused by insufficient font texture size in English font files.
 Fixed – Reward quantity display error when claiming rewards.
 Fixed – Material display issue for QP mech.
 Feature – Added reactivation prompt when the in-battle command menu is hidden.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.4.001 Update
notes.content:
Localization fixes.
 Fixed a bug with the countdown sound effect during matchmaking.
 Fixed abnormal material display issues for some mechas.
 Fixed certain UI display errors.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.3.001 Update
notes.content:
UI Optimization
 Mission Level Expansion
 Seasonal System for Battles

notes.title: Ver 0.10.003 Update
notes.content:
The closed beta test has ended.
The official version will be released soon.

notes.title: Ver 0.9.001 Updates
notes.content:
Bug Fixes and Updates

 Fixed an issue with water surfaces on the Dam map.
 Fixed a bug where the passive Guard effect would not take effect after the active effect of a Guard skill ended.
 Fixed the issue that when the poison circle is minimized, the status does not disappear after leaving the poison circle.
 Optimized the description for the Core - [Assault Module] status effect.
 Corrected logical errors in the Leader Core.
 Adjusted the duration of the status effect for the skill - [Polar Permafrost].
 Reduced the difficulty of Stage 20.
 In PvP battles, disconnecting or quitting during matchmaking will now deduct a participation count. The opponent remains unaffected and will have deducted durability restored.
 Fixed grid data issues on the Dam map bridge in PvP mode.
 Resolved a bug where core-related aura effects were not being applied.
 Fixed a visual glitch with the cooldown display for basic attacks.

notes.title: Ver 0.8.001 updates
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the black screen bug during loading in PVP.
 Fixed the issue where skill tips in the Mecha details couldn’t be closed during battle.
 Fixed the infinite evasion bug with the Mach Engineering core.
 Fixed the bug where terrain buffs weren’t updated during the formation stage.
 Fixed several localization issues.

notes.title: Ver 0.7.001 Updates
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed the blueprint maximum limit configuration issue.
 Fixed a core bug.
 Fixed an issue where health and shield deduction in skill prerequisites were not functioning correctly.
 Fixed an issue during PVP loading where if the opponent exited, the player didn’t receive a prompt and was returned to the matchmaking screen.
 Fixed the missing default avatar issue for Apostle.
 Fixed the description error in Level 14.
 Fixed an issue where reconnecting after disconnecting would result in an empty scene.
 Fixed an incorrect guardian prompt.
 Fixed several skill description issues.
 Fixed the missing skill sound effects.
 Fixed an issue where the Bullying skill would not deal damage properly.
 Fixed localization issues in Japanese for certain levels.
 Fixed a display issue with the skill indicator when there is no space to use charge-type skills.

notes.title: Ver 0.5.004 updates
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed energy cost and cooldown for the skill Cooperative Ion.
 Corrected the description of Tips.
 Fixed damage values for drill-type skills.
 Resolved incorrect FPC and ACE values when sending emails.
 Corrected the description of the skill Reaper Sharp Claw.
 Added a red dot notification when there are unread emails.
 Fixed an issue where FPC and experience values might not display correctly during battle results.
